newsitem.title: UK: Fennica sets 1.5 billion Fim securitised bond.
newsitem.headline: Fennica sets 1.5 billion Fim securitised bond.

text.p: Fennica (No 2) Plc has issued a three-tranche securitised bond for a total of 1.507 billion Finnish marks, joint lead managers ING Barings and Postipankki said.
